name: vscode-conan
description: Installs Conan 2 dependencies for each selected Conan profile and hands the CMake presets to CMake Tools.

conan.executable.description: The Conan 2 executable to run. Use a full path if Conan isn't on PATH.

languageModelTools.name: conan_getStatus
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show the Conan profiles, install state and CMake presets for a Conan CMake project.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Gets the Conan dependency status of a workspace folder that has a conanfile and a CMakeLists.txt: the selected host profiles and build profile, whether the last 'conan install' is still up to date, and the conan-* CMake configure presets available to CMake Tools. Read-only. Call this first to see whether profiles need selecting or dependencies need installing.

folder.description: Path or name of the workspace folder. Optional when only one Conan CMake project is open.

languageModelTools.name: conan_listProfiles
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the Conan profiles that dependencies can be installed for.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the Conan 2 profiles available on this machine (the output of 'conan profile list'). Read-only. Use the names with conan_selectProfiles.

languageModelTools.name: conan_selectProfiles
languageModelTools.userDescription: Choose which Conan profiles to install dependencies for.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Saves which Conan profiles a Conan CMake project installs dependencies for: one 'conan install' per host profile, all using the same build profile. Profile names must come from conan_listProfiles. The first time, it also sets cmake.configureOnOpen=false and cmake.useCMakePresets=always in the folder's .vscode/settings.json so CMake Tools waits for Conan. Does not install anything; call conan_installDependencies afterwards. Returns the updated status.

folder.description: Path or name of the workspace folder. Optional when only one Conan CMake project is open.

buildProfile.description: Build profile (-pr:b). Defaults to the folder's current build profile ('default' unless changed).

languageModelTools.name: conan_installDependencies
languageModelTools.userDescription: Install Conan dependencies for the selected profiles, then configure with CMake Tools.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs 'conan install' for each selected profile of a Conan CMake project, writes CMakeUserPresets.json so each profile appears as a conan-<profile>-<build type> configure preset, then selects one of those presets in CMake Tools and configures. Profiles must have been selected first (conan_selectProfiles). Skips the install if nothing has changed since the last one, unless force is true. Missing packages are built from source, which can take minutes. Returns per-profile results, the available presets and the preset that was configured. Building is done separately with CMake Tools.

folder.description: Path or name of the workspace folder. Optional when only one Conan CMake project is open.

force.description: Install even if nothing has changed since the last install. Default false.
